rationales: CH₄ is a covalent compound because its atoms share electrons.
KCl is an ionic compound formed from K⁺ and Cl⁻ ions.
NaCl is an ionic compound formed from Na⁺ and Cl⁻ ions.
CaO is an ionic compound formed from Ca²⁺ and O²⁻ ions.
The sixth period is not called a short period.
The sixth period is longer than a normal period.
The term long period applies to the fourth and fifth periods.
The sixth period is called a very long period because it contains 32 elements.
Goldstein discovered canal rays, not the proton itself.
J. J. Thomson discovered the electron.
Niels Bohr developed a model of the atom.
Rutherford is credited with discovering the proton.
18 g is the molar mass of water, not the mass of one molecule.
9.8 g is not the mass of one water molecule.
One water molecule has a mass of approximately 18 amu.
18 kg is not the mass of one water molecule.
Mendeleev did not arrange his table by electronic configuration.
Mendeleev arranged the elements mainly in order of increasing atomic mass.
Atomic number was used as the basis of the modern periodic table, not Mendeleev’s table.
Completion of a subshell was not the basis of Mendeleev’s table.
An ionic bond forms when electrons are transferred from one atom to another.
A covalent bond forms by sharing electrons.
A metallic bond involves attraction between metal ions and delocalized electrons.
A coordinate covalent bond forms when one atom supplies both shared electrons.
Acetic acid ionizes only partially in water, so it is not a strong electrolyte.
Acetic acid is a weak electrolyte because it ionizes only partially in water.
Acetic acid is a weak acid, not a strong acid.
Acetic acid is an acid, not a base.
Toothpaste is generally a colloid, not a true solution.
Starch in water forms a colloidal mixture, not a true solution.
Soap solution is generally colloidal rather than a true solution.
Ink dissolved or dispersed uniformly in water is the expected example of a true solution among these choices.
Increasing pressure does not generally increase a liquid’s vapour pressure at a fixed temperature.
Increasing temperature increases vapour pressure.
Greater molecular polarity generally strengthens attractions and does not increase vapour pressure.
Stronger intermolecular forces generally lower vapour pressure.
NaCl melts at about 801°C, not 600°C.
NaCl melts at about 801°C, which rounds to 800°C.
1000°C is higher than the melting point of NaCl.
1200°C is higher than the melting point of NaCl.
Fluorine has the highest electronegativity among the halogens.
Chlorine is more electronegative than bromine and iodine.
Bromine is more electronegative than iodine.
Iodine has the lowest electronegativity among these halogens.
A mixture can be separated into its components by physical methods.
A compound requires chemical methods to separate its elements.
A radical is not a mixture separable into components by ordinary physical methods.
An element cannot be separated into simpler substances by physical means.
Aluminium is the most abundant metal in Earth’s crust.
Gold is much less abundant than aluminium.
Silver is much less abundant than aluminium.
Platinum is much less abundant than aluminium.
Reduction is commonly associated with the loss of oxygen.
Oxidation is the addition of oxygen in a chemical reaction.
Evaporation is a change of state, not a redox process.
Conduction is the transfer of heat or electricity, not the addition of oxygen.
Air is a mixture of gases, so it is a gas-in-gas solution.
Gas in a solid describes a different type of solution.
Solid in a gas does not describe the composition of air.
Gas in a liquid describes a solution such as carbon dioxide in water.
